name: rythra
description: A modular, framework-agnostic Lavalink client for modern TypeScript runtimes.

scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:facade && bun run build:docs
scripts.build:packages: bun run build:core && bun run build:protocol && bun run build:persistence && bun run build:metrics && bun run build:plugins && bun run build:types && bun run build:connector-discordjs
scripts.build:core: tsup packages/core/src/index.ts --format esm --out-dir packages/core/dist && tsc packages/core/src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --outDir packages/core/dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.build:protocol: tsup packages/protocol/src/index.ts --format esm --out-dir packages/protocol/dist && tsc packages/protocol/src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --outDir packages/protocol/dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.build:persistence: tsup packages/persistence/src/index.ts --format esm --out-dir packages/persistence/dist && tsc packages/persistence/src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --outDir packages/persistence/dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.build:metrics: tsup packages/metrics/src/index.ts --format esm --out-dir packages/metrics/dist && tsc packages/metrics/src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --outDir packages/metrics/dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.build:plugins: tsup packages/plugins/src/index.ts --format esm --out-dir packages/plugins/dist && tsc packages/plugins/src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --outDir packages/plugins/dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.build:types: tsup packages/types/src/index.ts --format esm --out-dir packages/types/dist && tsc packages/types/src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --outDir packages/types/dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.build:connector-discordjs: tsup packages/connectors/discordjs/src/index.ts --format esm --out-dir packages/connectors/discordjs/dist && tsc packages/connectors/discordjs/src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --outDir packages/connectors/discordjs/dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.build:facade: tsup index.ts --format esm,cjs --out-dir dist && tsc index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ESNext --outDir dist --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax
scripts.check:packages: bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:versions
